name: Streax Professional Hold and Play Funky Hair Colour Flirty Red 100gm
description:
Streax Professional Hold and Play Funky Hair Colour – Flirty Red (100gm)
Country of Origin: Bangladesh

Express yourself with bold, vibrant hair using Streax Professional Hold and Play Funky Hair Colour. This semi-permanent hair colour delivers instant, eye-catching results without the need for a developer, making it easy to switch up your look whenever you like.

Key Features & Benefits:

Instant Vibrant Colour: Achieve striking, semi-permanent results instantly.

Customizable Shades: Mix with other Funky Colours to create your own unique shade.

Easy Application: Can be used directly, no developer required.

Safe Formula: Free from ammonia and peroxide, gentle on hair.

Fun & Trendy: Part of the Hold & Play Funky Colour range, perfect for adventurous, stylish looks.

Available Shades in the Range: Crazy Violet, Wonder Blue, Glorious Green, Flirty Red

Perfect for frequent colour changes, this hair colour is ideal for anyone wanting a fun, bold, and trendy look.
